# Load input objects

```{r load_objects}
load(file.path(
  base_path,
  "scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/03_sce_analysis/03_marker_conservation/cons_markers_hsc.RData"
))

hsc_nDGEs <- readRDS(file.path(
  base_path,
  "scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/03_sce_analysis/02_DESeq2_crossspecies/05_nres/PC_0.05_FC_1.5/res_hsc_celltype_dfs"
))

hsc_sig <- read.delim(
  file.path(base_path, "manuscript1/hsc_signature_table.csv"),
  sep = ";"
)
```

# Modify adjusted p-value threshold of nDEGs

## Compute counts & signature overlaps across p-value thresholds

```{r ndge_thresholds}
p_try <- c(
  0.000001, 0.00001, 0.0001, 0.0005,
  0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05,
  0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 1.1
)

p_chr <- as.character(p_try)

# one vector of unique signature genes per p threshold (across all cell types)
signature_genes_by_p <- setNames(vector("list", length(p_chr)), p_chr)

res_list <- list()
i <- 1L

for (ct in names(hsc_nDGEs)) {

  # expected "signature" genes for this cell type from conservation object
  expected <- rownames(
    markers_conservation_hsc[[ct]][
      complete.cases(markers_conservation_hsc[[ct]]),
    ]
  )

  for (p in p_try) {

    genes_p <- hsc_nDGEs[[ct]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(padj < p) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 12) %>%   # 12 pairwise contrasts
      dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
      unique()

    overlap_genes <- intersect(expected, genes_p)

    res_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
      celltype            = ct,
      padj                = p,
      n_nDEGs             = length(genes_p),
      n_signature_genes   = length(overlap_genes)
    )
    i <- i + 1L

    key <- as.character(p)
    signature_genes_by_p[[key]] <- union(
      signature_genes_by_p[[key]],
      overlap_genes
    )
  }
}

nDEG_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)
```

```{r save_ndge}
saveRDS(nDEG_df, file.path(out_dir, "nDEG_df.rds"))
saveRDS(signature_genes_by_p, file.path(out_dir, "signature_genes_by_p.rds"))
```

# Modify log2FC threshold of conserved markers

## Load HSC object and prepare Seurat object

```{r load_hsc_sce}
sce_hsc <- readRDS(file.path(
  base_path,
  "scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/10_anns/sce_hsc-10"
))

metadata <- sce_hsc@colData@listData %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Sample)

rownames(metadata) <- paste(metadata$Barcode, metadata$Object_ID, sep = "_")

cleaner_data <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
  counts    = sce_hsc@assays@data@listData[["logcounts"]],
  meta.data = metadata
)

species    <- sort(unique(metadata$Species_ID))
cell_types <- sort(unique(metadata$celltypes))
```

## nDEG signature genes per cell type

```{r ndge_by_ct}
ndge_genes_by_ct <- setNames(
  lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
    x <- hsc_nDGEs[[ct]]
    if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))

    x %>%
      dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::count(gene) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n == 12) %>%
      dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
      unique()
  }),
  cell_types
)
```

## Compute conserved markers across log2FC thresholds

```{r marker_thresholds}
t_try  <- c(0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.1,
            0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4,
            0.5, 0.7, 1)

t_chr <- as.character(t_try)

markers_all_thresholds <- setNames(vector("list", length(t_chr)), t_chr)
common_marker_stats    <- setNames(vector("list", length(t_chr)), t_chr)
signature_genes_by_t   <- setNames(vector("list", length(t_chr)), t_chr)

for (t in t_try) {
  message("logfc.threshold = ", t)
  t_name <- as.character(t)

  markers_list <- list()

  for (s in species) {
    species_subset <- subset(cleaner_data, subset = Species_ID == s)

    for (ct in cell_types) {
      cells <- metadata %>%
        dplyr::filter(Species_ID == s, celltypes == ct) %>%
        rownames()

      cells_in_obj <- intersect(colnames(species_subset), cells)
      if (length(cells_in_obj) < 3L) next

      markers <- Seurat::FindMarkers(
        object          = species_subset,
        ident.1         = cells_in_obj,
        only.pos        = TRUE,
        logfc.threshold = t,
        min.pct         = 0.1
      )

      if (nrow(markers) == 0L) next

      markers_list[[paste(s, ct, sep = "_")]] <- markers
    }
  }

  markers_all_thresholds[[t_name]] <- markers_list

  stats_t <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {

    genes_by_species <- lapply(species, function(s) {
      key <- paste(s, ct, sep = "_")
      if (is.null(markers_list[[key]])) {
        character(0)
      } else {
        rownames(markers_list[[key]])
      }
    })

    if (any(lengths(genes_by_species) == 0L)) {
      common_genes <- character(0)
    } else {
      common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, genes_by_species)
    }

    overlap <- intersect(common_genes, ndge_genes_by_ct[[ct]])

    tibble::tibble(
      celltype                     = ct,
      logfc_threshold              = t,
      n_common_markers_all_species = length(common_genes),
      n_signature_genes            = length(overlap),
      signature_genes              = list(overlap)
    )
  }))

  common_marker_stats[[t_name]]  <- dplyr::select(stats_t, -signature_genes)
  signature_genes_by_t[[t_name]] <- unique(unlist(stats_t$signature_genes))
}

common_marker_stats_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(common_marker_stats)
```

```{r save_marker_results}
saveRDS(markers_all_thresholds, file.path(out_dir, "markers_all_thresholds.rds"))
saveRDS(common_marker_stats_df, file.path(out_dir, "common_marker_stats_df.rds"))
saveRDS(signature_genes_by_t, file.path(out_dir, "signature_genes_by_t.rds"))
```
